options.name: append
options.description: If C(yes), other filesystems may be mounted besides the ones listed in C(fstab). If C(no), any mounts other than the ones in C(fstab) will be removed.

options.name: fstab
options.description: List of mount points. Each element is a dictionary. Most people will only need to specify C(src), C(mount), and C(options). The rest are advanced options.
